page.layout: One printed title page. Centred title lines at the top, a printer's emblem with motto banner in the middle, and the imprint lines below. Stamps, seal and handwriting are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Accesfit DE IVRE REGNI apud Scotos Dialogus,

page.notes: Engraved printer's emblem: a crown above a column between two figures, with a laurel wreath and a banner. Banner words legible: CONSILII (left), PIETAS (centre), POLITIA (right); the lower-left banner is not readable, and the lower-right banner is not legible. Date printed as CIↃ. IↃ. XCIII, with reversed-C numerals, rendered as MDXCIII. Not transcribed: the library stamp "BIBLIOTECA ROMA", the oval seal, the dry-stamp at right, and the manuscript ownership inscription at the foot ("Ex libris J. C. ... Margelino 1645"), which is handwriting.
